tips: Glass breaks into glass shards unless mined with Silk Touch; shards craft back into glass
Composters turn plants, food, straw, bark and sawdust into bone meal
Kill a mob an Axolotl is fighting to gain Regeneration
Some Pillager outposts hold caged Allays
Leather boots let you walk on powder snow
Compasses point to spawn in the Overworld, to the portal you came through in the Nether, and to the exit portal in the End
Lava flowing over soul soil next to blue ice turns into basalt
Water and lava make cobblestone, or other stones when the lava touches certain blocks
Every player can take an elytra from each End ship
Facing a Creeper blast with a shield cuts the damage; better shields block more
Sweet berry bushes slow you down and hurt you unless you wear leggings
A totem of undying saves you from your hand or your charm slot
Lava buckets are a great furnace fuel
